segment.source: Encoding formats, support HEX, HSB, RGB.
segment.target: Encoding formats, suporte HEX, HSB, RGB.

segment.source: Set the component to controlled mode. Will lock the display color if controlled by.
segment.target: Definir o component para controlled modo. Irá lock o exibir cor se controlled por.

segment.source: Triggers event for customizing color panels, provide options click and hover.
segment.target: Triggers event para customizing cor painéis, fornecer opções clique e sobreposição.

segment.source: Set the color to a single or a gradient color via mode.
segment.target: Definir o cor para a single ou a gradient cor via modo.

segment.source: ColorPicker supports solid and gradient values, trigger sizing, alpha control, text rendering, value synchronization, hover or click triggers, and preset palettes.
segment.target: ColorPicker oferece suporte solid e gradient values, gatilho sizing, alpha controle, texto rendering, valor synchronization, sobreposição ou clique triggers, e predefinido palettes.

segment.source: Pick solid colors or gradients from a compact trigger.
segment.target: Pick solid cores ou gradients de a compacto gatilho.

segment.source: Set the presets color of the color picker.
segment.target: Definir o presets cor de o cor picker.

segment.source: Renders the default text of the trigger, effective when showText is true. When customizing text, you can use showText as a function to return custom text.
segment.target: Renders the default text of the trigger, effective when showText is true. When customizing text, you can use showText as a function to return custom text.

segment.source: Color block container with background color, border styles
segment.target: Contêiner do bloco de cor com cor de fundo e estilos de borda

segment.source: Color block element with actual selected color styles
segment.target: Elemento de cor do bloco com os estilos da cor realmente selecionada

segment.source: Description text content with font styles and color
segment.target: Conteúdo de texto descritivo com estilos de fonte e cor

segment.source: Popup panel root container with background color, shadow effects, color selection panel, slider controls and preset colors
segment.target: Contêiner raiz do painel flutuante com cor de fundo, efeitos de sombra, painel de seleção de cores, controles deslizantes e cores predefinidas

segment.source: Trigger container with border styles, transition animations, size controls, displaying color block and text content
segment.target: Contêiner do gatilho com estilos de borda, animações de transição e controles de tamanho, exibindo o bloco de cor e o conteúdo de texto

segment.source: Customize the semantic structure style of ColorPicker with semantic part styles.
segment.target: Personalize o estilo da estrutura semântica do ColorPicker com estilos de partes semânticas.

segment.source: Ant Design supports three trigger sizes: small, default and large.If a large or small trigger is desired, set the size property to either large or small.respectively. Omit the size property for a trigger with the default size.
segment.target: Ant Design supports three trigger sizes: small, default and large.If a large or small trigger is desired, set the size property to either large or small.respectively. Omit the size property for a trigger with the default size.

segment.source: Value now defaults to TwoWay binding for both solid and gradient pickers, so edits update the ViewModel without an explicit binding mode.
segment.target: Valor now defaults para TwoWay vinculação para both solid e gradient pickers, so edits update o ViewModel sem an explicit vinculação modo.

segment.source: Try a color or gradient in the panel, then choose Confirm to update the bound value. Cancel, Escape, or dismissing the panel discards the draft. Clearing a color also requires confirmation.
segment.target: Experimente uma cor ou um gradiente no painel e escolha Confirmar para atualizar o valor vinculado. Cancelar, Escape ou fechar o painel descarta as alterações. Limpar a cor também exige confirmação.
